claims.text: AC 107-2A states: 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft,' and if connection cannot be reestablished, 'start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link'.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft

claims.text: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control... only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control (LOC).
claims.quote: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control (i.e., the remote PIC designation) to each other may do so only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control (LOC).
conditions: transfer of control between remote pilots

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message.
claims.quote: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message.

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, both the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts to notify the user.
claims.quote: When the C2 link is lost, both the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts to notify the user.

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If the link is not restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, the Autel Enterprise App will display a warning and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
conditions: C2 link lost for more than 10 seconds

gaps.text: Autel manual says the drone continues in its current state after link loss, conflicting with FAA guidance to discontinue flight and inspect the control link.
Autel: if link restored within 10 seconds, control returns to remote; incident reports claim Return To Home failed and platform flew away.
Autel's Signal Loss Action upon persistent loss (C007) contrasts with reports of continued uncontrolled flight after takeoff.
Unverified incident details in reports; no verified evidence of actual control-link loss procedures vs. claimed outcomes.

text: FAA guidance says reestablish the control link if possible and discontinue flight until inspection if it cannot be reestablished. FAA guidance also requires two certificated remote pilots in VLOS with LOC. Autel manual says on link loss the drone stays in its current state; if restored within 10 seconds control returns; if not, the app warns and a Signal Loss Action is executed. Incident reports are unverified accounts of loss after takeoff, platform flying away, failed RTH, and not recovered. Gap: Autel's continued-flight behavior conflicts with FAA guidance, and the incident details remain unverified open questions.
